neighbours.label: ' for' introducing the target of an optimisation: optimized / tuned / adapted for X
fire: The latest browser is optimized for laptops with small screens.
Our servers are tuned for heavy video traffic at night.
The camera software was optimized for low-light photos.
This compiler is optimised for older Intel processors.
The racing tires were tuned for wet tracks.
The menu layout is optimized for phones and tablets.
Each model is fine-tuned for a single language.
The website is optimized for fast loading on slow networks.
quiet: The latest browser was released for free last spring.
Our servers are paid for by the university each year.
The camera was a gift for her twelfth birthday.
This compiler is famous for its clear error messages.
The racing team waited for the rain to stop.
The menu has been printed for the summer season.
Each model is sold for less than fifty dollars.
The website asked for my email address twice.

notes: Card: ' for' x19 after optimized/optimised/tuned, plus ' optimized' itself. Probe: 'optimized for' 1.0, 'tuned for' 0.41, 'designed for' 0.23, 'waited for' 0.01; 'optimized' with no 'for' 0.57, so near misses avoid the word optimized.
